text: Thurston Xane is a Forsaken mage trainer located in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.

Thuwd is an orc artisan skinning trainer located in the Drag in Orgrimmar. He is found skinning a dead boar. Using Track Beasts reveals it to be a Corrupted Mottled Boar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Kamari in front of the building.

Thunker Axeljink was the a member of the Council of Tirisfal and the father of Krank Axeljink. He died while defending Gnomeregan against the invading troggs. Aegwynn suggested him to join the New Council of Tirisfal but Meryl told her he is dead and instead his son, Krank joined.
Thura is an orc warrior and the half-niece of Broxigar and Varok Saurfang. Her father is the half-brother of Varok and Broxigar, having the same mother but different fathers.

Thundermar is a Wildhammer dwarf settlement in the Twilight Highlands. With the rest of Thundermar in ruins, the remaining Wildhammer currently make their home either here, or in Kirthaven. From Thundermar, the Wildhammer launch hit and run attacks on the town ruins to salvage supplies and to thin the numbers of the Dragonmaw clan, who are also trying to gain control over the ruins. Thundermar's leader is Colin Thundermar, leader of the Thundermar clan, who generally don't get along with the other clans, especially the Firebeards. Aside from a Dragonmaw raid every now and then, the town is relatively peaceful. Although in a time of war, the denizens of the town continue with their lives, rai
Thurman Belva is a human located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Thunderslash is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Slithering Serpents and Cobra Commander traits.
Thunderfist is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Master of Combinations and Concordance of the Legionfall traits.
Thunderlord Champion was a Thunderlord orc located in Iron Siegeworks and taken out by the followers sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
Thunderlord Warbringer was an orc located in Frostfire Ridge. He was taken out by the followers.
Tia Shortsleeve is a human located at Khadgar's Tower in Talador. She provides Tia Shortsleeve's Short Sleeve Shirt for 1 copper.
Tiffany Cartier is a human jewelcrafting supplies vendor in Dalaran.
Tiernan Anvilheart is a level 72 dwarf weapons vendor located at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in the Grizzly Hills.
Tiger Style was a Windwalker monk PvP talent, available at level 52.
Tidesage Morris is a human located at Braxton Lodge in Stormsong Valley.
Tidesage Bankson is a human located in the Umber Shore in Tiragarde Sound.
Tideguard Pontus is a human located in Brineworks in Stormsong Valley. He transforms into a k'thir.
Tide Lord Vorshasz is a naga lord located on the expedition isles.
Tilli Thistlefuzz is a dwarf enchanting vendor located in the Great Forge in Ironforge.
Tilloa was a human female and a student of Stalvan Mistmantle.
Tim Street is a level 74 human stable master located at Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills.
Tilling was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Tilly Molsworth is a human located just in front of the Temple of Five Dawns in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle. She also appears in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.

Timecap'n Hooktail is an infinite dragon pirate serving as the penultimate boss of Tazavesh, the Veiled Market. In her human form, she goes by the name Captain Caulle Whiphook. She is located at Boralus Harbor.
Timothy Worthington is a human artisan tailoring trainer located on Theramore Isle of Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.

Timothy Daniels is a human reagent and poison vendor located at Orebor Harborage in Zangarmarsh. He trained under the instruction of master rogue Lee Sparks, who is referred to as his mentor. Timothy Daniels prefers to be addressed by his title, "The Specialist". Timothy Daniels sells the standard reagents, as well as a comprehensive variety of poisons. However, he sells only the high level versions of deadly, instant, and wound poisons.

Timmanrug was a pit lord. He dueled with Fraweth Whiteshield in the Third War. He has a wing hung limp, scarred and useless, due to a wound inflicted by the dwarf who lost an eye in the process. They agreed to meet once again some years later in the Blasted Lands. The two fought again and the battle was a bloody one: the paladin attacked the pit lord at the belly with his greataxe and the demon's burning blood burned up the knight's skin. After that, Whiteshield hit at the demon's front knees and Timmanrug responded with his fel warblade. It is unknown if anybody won or if they both died.
Tipvigut is a tuskarr general goods vendor found in Kamagua in the Howling Fjord.
Timofey Oshenko is a human engineering trainer inside the Like Clockwork shop within the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran. He owed Alard Schmied a favor.
Tina Mudclaw is a pandaren farmer and a member of The Tillers. She is the kind yet spoiled daughter of Haohan Mudclaw who loves expensive gifts.
Tina Fang is a night elf found in Stormshield Stronghold in Ashran.
Tirathon Saltheril is a blood elf demon hunter. He is the first boss in the Vault of the Wardens.
Tiris Rainshadow is a night elf who, along with Lorel Sagefeather, seeks help to handle Gorebeak a giant bird that have been corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare.
Timothy Green is a human located at Hook Point in Boralus. He runs Green's Alchemy & Potions.
Tiran Blackwood is a human located in Boralus. He speaks with Jaina Proudmoore about former Theramore Colonel Lorena.
Tipa Stillwind is a night elf located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Tiyani is a night elf food and drink vendor located in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
Tisa Martine is a human located by the bar in Bruuk's Corner in the Military Ward of Ironforge.
Titan's Thunder is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Wilderness Expert trait.
Titus Varney is a human located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Titanic Rage is a Fury warrior talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Dancing Blades.

Tog'thar is an orc warrior. He was part of Gol'dir's team investigating the Syndicate in Durnholde Keep, where he has since been held captive. His companion Krusk wanted him rescued. Afterwards, he can be found at the Eastpoint Tower, suffering from the Durnholde Syndrome.
Toldren Deepiron is a dwarf priest trainer located in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge.
Tognus Flintfire is a dwarf artisan blacksmithing trainer located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Toddrick is a human butcher and meat vendor located in the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

Tojanida is a type of water elemental creature found in the Abyssal Maw of the Elemental Plane. Their hierarchy includes juvenile, adult, and elder forms. Elder tojanidas can also be summoned by druids using a spell, Summon Nature's Ally VIII.
Tom Hegger is a human located on the docks of Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra. He is secretly a member of the Cult of the Damned.
Tobias Mistmantle is a worgen warrior who was presumably part of Darius Crowley's rebels during the civil war.
Tomarrek is a night elf armor vendor located at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
Togar is an orc located in Orgrimmar. He sold high level Cataclysm trade goods for Justice Points.
Tod'bank is an orc located on the second floor of the Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.
Togra is an orc located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. She also appears on the gunship above the Seething Shore during the character boost training.
Toe Knee is a human located in the Opera Hall in Return to Karazhan as part of the Opera Hall: Westfall Story encounter.
Tom Fishbury is a human located at Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound.
Toht Twofingers is a dwarf located in Deadwash in Stormsong Valley. He joined the Dragonscale Expedition and is found next to Emilia Bellocq at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores.
Tobias Troutman is a human located in Pinky's Groggery in Boralus.
Tor'phan is an orc cloth and leather armor vendor located in Magar's Cloth Goods in the Drag in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Snang.
Torgah is an orc general goods vendor located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. During Death Rising, she defended Julie Osworth and Broxel Goldgrasp.
Toral is an orc blacksmithing vendor located at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
Tonya Lightbrew is a human inscription vendor located in the mage tower of Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if she survived the Ironmarch.
Torgal was a human from Lordaeron who traveled with Arthas to fight Mal'Ganis in Northrend.
Torag Stonefury is an orc located at the Cracking Plains in Frostfire Ridge.
Torg Earkeeper is a dead orc located at the Bloodthorn Bloom in Gorgrond. He's the mate of Kaz the Shrieker and the father of Cutter.
Tomken Thunderfist is an orc shaman located at Deliverance Point in the Broken Shore.

Toren Snapjoint was a human necromancer who hid himself in a cave near Ironforge in Dun Morogh. He was a master of disciples who would raid graveyards to raise the dead. When Molus Blackburn found his hideout, he wanted the cave all to himself. To get rid go him, he disguised himself as a Bronzebeard dwarf and tasked the adventurer to take him out. They were successful.

Tongo's Hideout is the personal hideout of the Zandalari gang leader Tongo in the southern part of Exiles' Enclave in Vol'dun. In addition to Tongo himself, his pet hyenas Gnarl and Snarl can also be found in the building, feasting on a dead Zandalari Exile.
Toothless Eddard is a human located in Briny Flats in Stormsong Valley.
Torren Squarejaw is a dwarf located in Thelsamar in Loch Modan. He is affiliated with the Explorers' League.
Tortusk is the leader of the Razormane tribe that resides around Thorn Hill. Tortusk travels and fights mounted on his raptor Fez.
Tormentor Sipe is an orc death knight found tormenting Spearguard Du'mont in a small unnamed camp in southern Zul'Drak.
Torin Coalheart is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Torwa Rimeheart is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Tormil was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Tormentor is a Vengeance demon hunter PvP talent, available at level 20.
Tornado Kicks is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Inner Peace (artifact trait) trait.
Torrential Barrage is an Arcane mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Aegwynn's Wrath, Crackling Energy (artifact trait), Everywhere at Once, and Sloooow Down traits.
Torostrasz is a red dragon ghost located in Veiled Ossuary in Thaldraszus. He is only active at night.

Touarril is a male human turned shade. He is a priest and part of the Scourge. The creature has skin of deepest black. Its head has no distinct features other than a pair of eyes that glow with an unnerving white light. Simple black velvet apparel with a vague resemblance to monastic robes shrouds its frame. He speaks Abyssal, Common, and Orcish.
Trag is an orc stable master located in Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest.
Tragg was an orc belonging to the Warsong clan. He, Rekshak, and few others orcs found Thrall. His status is unknown.
Trader Alorn is a taunka general goods vendor located at Taunka'le Village in the Borean Tundra.
Tradesman Kontor is an orc trade supplies vendor located at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.
Trader Jina is a pandaren general goods vendor located at Paw'don Village in the Jade Forest.

Trade Prince Leeko was a trade prince on Kezan. One hundred years before the Alliance-Horde war, he sent kaja'miners deeper than anyone had been before. His workers had to find a cart's worth of ore before their overseers would let them go home. A miner of his named Miz encountered and killed Rakalaz in one of his mines.

Trader Darakk is an orc located in the Frostwall garrison town hall. He sells various items for gold, including pets and mounts. He sells "local supplies" and has the on-click voice of Frostwolf Orcs despite being green.
Trader Caelen is a dwarf located at the Forge of Fate in Dalaran.
Trainee Skyshadow is a night elf vendor found at the Wardens' Redoubt on the Isle of the Watchers in Azsuna.
Transfusion was a Frost and Unholy death knight PvP talent. It was available at level 20.
Tranquilizing Darts is a hunter PvP talent, available at level 20.
Traugh is an orc blacksmithing trainer located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He assisted in its defense during the Legion invasions.
Trapper's Shirt is the starting shirt for orc, tauren, and troll hunters.
Trapper's Pants was the starting legs for orc, tauren, and troll hunters. They are sold by Ollanus in the Drag in Orgrimmar.
Trant is a human warrior who traveled to Outland with his companions, Haneth, Dolmont, Nuji Kodosbreath, and Vlac.
Trapper Kiefer is a human located at the Goodgrub Smoking Pit in Winterspring.
Trapper's Vest is the starting chest for orc, tauren, and troll hunters.

Travard is a human paladin and the leader of the Tyr's Guard since the Third War. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, he came to Dalaran and requested the aid of the reformed Knights of the Silver Hand to ensure the protection of the The Silver Hand (artifact), the legendary weapon of the Keeper Tyr sealed in his tomb. However, although they managed to secure the artifact, all members of the Tyrs Guard were killed by abominations of the Void during the battle, leaving only Travard as the last member of the organization. Later, the old paladin discovered that Tyr's tomb had not been completely collapsed, and decided to watch over it alone for several years. When a hero alongside
Traveling Warrior is an orc standing with Traveling Son in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
Traveling Son is an orc child standing with Traveling Warrior in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
Trauga Bloodhelm is an orc located on the Defiant Dragonscale in Durotar.

Trenton Lighthammer is a high elf blacksmith located at Sandsorrow Watch in Tanaris. He is a member of the blacksmithing group called the Mithril Order and is searching for the legendary sword known as Sul'thraze the Lasher, helped by a sand troll called Mazoga. Prior to the Cataclysm, he had recently finished training with Galvan the Ancient as one of his finest pupils, and could be found pounding away at an anvil near the southern gates of Gadgetzan. Adventurers with blacksmithing who were training in armorsmithing would come to him for additional recipes, creating mithril armor for Trenton, and he, in turn, admitted them to the Order. He also had adventurers bring him troll temper from Zu
Trenton Ramalot is a dwarf general goods vendor located in Ironforge Airfield in Dun Morogh.
Trevor Page is a human found in the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.
Tremane was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Trevor Hightide is a human located at the Carver's Harbor in Drustvar.
Tricky Nick is a human located in Hook Point in Boralus. Next to him is a box with a Smuggled Brutosaur Hatchling.
Tregan Hillbury is a human located outside the Barracks in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.
Tristane Shadowstone is a dwarf located in Brewnall Village in Dun Morogh. She takes a walk down the road every now and then, but returns rather quickly.
Trok is a young orc male who lives with his father, Kranal Fiss, near Grol'dom Farm in the Northern Barrens. He is running from a swarm of bees.

Colonel Troteman was the commanding officer of Bravo Company. He was later promoted and was known as Marshal Troteman during the Alliance's campaign in Pandaria, where he became a prominent officer in Lion's Landing.
Tristan Bailer is a human located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus. He can be found playing Hearthstone against Joseph Healer.
Tronaar is a man'ari eredar located in Triumvirate's End in the Eredath. He is an ally of Arzaal and provides an Argunite Cluster when spoken to.
Tumi is an orc heavy armor vendor located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. It appears that she is the sister of Sumi and the daughter of Saru Steelfury.
Tunkk is an orc leatherworking vendor located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
Tukk is a jungle troll general goods vendor located in Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
Truk Wildbeard is a Wildhammer dwarf food and drink vendor located in Wildhammer Keep at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.

Tupan is a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon rider under Falstad Dragonreaver. Rhonin had followed him through Hasic to find the gryphon riders base camp and try to convince the dwarves to help take Rhonin to Grim Batol.
Tundra Stalker is a Death knight talent located in the 10th tier of the Frost Tree.
Tunari is a jungle troll priest trainer located in the Darkspear Training Grounds of the Darkspear Isle on the Echo Isles in Durotar. When Zalazane returned, she defended the area.
Truman Weaver is a human located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Tulgorz Grogfist is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He could only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.

Truth is a human priest located in the northeastern alcove in the Hall of Balance in the Netherlight Temple if the advancement upgrade Blessed Seals has been chosen. Players can exchange 100 Order Resources and receive a single Seal of Broken Fate from Truth once a week.
Tuesday is a Dark Iron dwarf located at the Ruby Feast in Valdrakken. She was replaced by Alchemist Flemthroat during the alpha.
Tuluradormi is a bronze dragon located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.

Turok was the leader of an outlaw band of ogres that rebelled against the Horde during the First War. Griselda, the daughter of Warchief Blackhand, at one point ran off with Turok. In response, Blackhand's forces tracked the rebels to the Deadmines and killed them.
Turuk Amberstill is a dwarf weapon vendor located at Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh.
Turhaw is an orc meat and drink vendor located in Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. He has been missing since the Cataclysm, presumably having been killed in the Thousand Needles disaster.
Turrana is a tauren general goods vendor located at Camp Una'fe in the Southern Barrens.

Turyen was an SI:7 agent assigned to spy on the Nathanos Blightcaller. During the course of this mission, he was discovered and ultimately killed. His skeleton is found at Marris Stead, along with his SI:7 Insignia.
Turga is an orc located in the Frostwall's Tailoring Emporium. She accepts Sumptuous Fur work orders creating Hexweave Cloths.
Turkino is a night elf located in the Gnarled Branch at the Dreamgrove in Val'sharah.
Turbulent Armament is a token that is used to create a weapon suitable for a character's specialization.
Turanis was an elf that was training to become a demon hunter. While he survived the first part of the ritual, he was driven mad, attacked his fellow trainees and died while fighting them.
Twain The Tester was a human located in several copies on Programmer Isle.
Twilight Corruption is a Discipline priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Embrace Shadow.

Tydormu is a bronze dragon posing as a high elf just behind the instance portal of Hyjal Summit in the Caverns of Time. He is notable for selling the pieces of the Tier 6-sets for the nine basic classes.

Two-Heads was a member of the Gordunni Gladiator Team of Ancient Draenor: the previous year's team champions of the Crimson Ring tournament. He was beheaded by Varian "Lo'Gosh" Wrynn, during the fight between the Gordunni gladiator team and Rehgar Earthfury's gladiator team.
Twisted Faith is a talent in the priest Shadow tree, you will need to spend 7 points in Shadow to max it. It increases shadow spell damage and increases spell hit rating depending on spirit.
Tylos Dawnrunner is a blood elf found within Sunreaver Pavilion at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. He was present during Death Rising.
Tyllan is a blood elf child found in Zul'Aman. He has been hexxed into a frog waiting to be saved.
Twixnee Boltgear is a goblin located at the Ruins of Na'gwa in , where she manages a holo-projector for Gazmolf Futzwangler.
Tyrnas was a female night elf killed by Ralaar and Arvell while they had lost their minds to the Pack Form.
Tyrannical Gladiator's Desecration is the Season 13 Death knight arena set.

Tyrathan Khort is a human hunter in the Alliance army, but not especially high ranking. He was found by Chen Stormstout after being injured in battle and brought to the Shado-Pan Monastery to heal, where the Shado-Pan had him care for the recovering Vol'jin so their opposite personalities would achieve balance. Tyrathan was haunted by doubt after losing his scouting squad to a sha attack in the Jade Forest. He and Vol'jin eventually become friends, even making a pact to kill whomever killed the other.
Tyven is a night elf Sentinel who crafted a belt woven from the manes of the fabled Seven Lions.
Ug'thok is an orc located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. He is an apprentice of Saru Steelfury. He assists Saru in forging a weapon for the adventurer.
Uhgar is an orc weapon vendor located in Razor Hill in Durotar. He was present during Varok Saurfang's rebellion.

Ukor is an orc peon located by the path east of the Valley of Trials in Durotar. A kind-hearted soul who likes to help out, he braved the beasts along the road from Razor Hill to the Valley of Trials to deliver a bundle of food. However, when he arrived there he found that the Valley isn't in need of food; so, instead, he asks a young hero to bring the unused food back to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn.
Ullanna is a night elf trade goods vendor located at the Auberdine Refugee Camp in Darkshore. Before the Cataclysm, she was located at the Grove of the Ancients.

Ulthaan was a night elf meat vendor located at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. He died when the Horde conquered the area: he tried to flee, but was killed on the road north-west of the Refuge, where his body lies unburied.
Uma Bartulm is a human herbalism and alchemy vendor located on Theramore Isle of Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.

Uglaz was a character from the canceled Warcraft Adventures: Lord of the Clans. He was one of the orcs who made a pact with Lieutenant Blackmoore along with Rend and Maim. He appeared near the end of the game, presenting Grommash Hellscream as a captive to Blackmoore. Since he was an underling of Rend and Maim, he was presumably a member of the Black Tooth Grin clan as well.
Umi Thorson is a dwarf serving the Alliance in Alterac Valley. She patrols the Irondeep Mine while it's under Alliance control.
Ul'Tomon is a male nerubian spiderlord mage, and is the Sundered Monolith's chief seer. He was 39 years old when Brann met him.
Udin was a dwarf under Rom's command. He was tortured to death by the forces of Sintharia.
Ujumqin (real name unknown) is a member of Blizzard Entertainment's quality assurance. He posts in the Bug Report and PTR Bug Report forums.
Ultan Blackgorge is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Umi Togglevolt is a dwarf. She is a graduate of Brock's School of Mining and Surveying and Gremlock's School of Caterers.
Uktar is an orc located at the Dread Grotto in Blackrock Foundry.
Uk'urogg is a dire orc located at the Dread Grotto in Blackrock Foundry.
Ulrich Forgeworth is a dwarf located at the Bizmo's Brawlpub and Brawl'gar Arena as part of the Warhammer Council encounter.
Ultanok is a dragon turtle located in a secret cave beneath the waterfall at Broken Teeth, in Neltharion's Lair.
Ulgthax is a fel lord located in Val'sharah during the Legion Assaults.

Ulfar is the last of the Drust druids and the leader of the Thornspeakers, an order of Kul Tiran druids based in Ulfar's Den in Drustvar, who train in the old ways of the Drust from before the time of Gorak Tul. He is the last Drust of this organization originally created by his people. Ulfar does not think highly of Gorak Tul, and believes Tul's twisted ways have disgraced their kind. Ulfar can be a hard teacher, but he's fair.
Umbilicus Eternus is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Meat Shield (death knight artifact trait) and Veinrender traits.

Uleg is a member of the Horde and one of the three spies sent to gather information on Theramore and the Alliance. Marg Nighteye would send him and his companion Thargil to gain information on a vessel that just landed, the Bleeding Sparrow, in hopes of gaining some political documents. They would succeed at finding the information that they were looking for but dropped it in the sea when they ended up getting caught. Thargil was captured by the Theramore Guard while Uleg escaped. Marg would then send Uleg to deliver a report of the situation to Nazeer Bloodpike.
Ulfrik Stoutarm is a dwarf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Ulfie Proudkeg is a dwarf located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span. He tends to the forge.
Umbrelskul is an ancient blue dragon, the son of Malygos and Sindragosa, and the final boss of the Azure Vault.
Un'Thuwa (or Un'thuwa) is a jungle troll mage trainer located in Razor Hill in Durotar. Before the Cataclysm, he was located in Sen'jin Village.
Unbreakable Armor is a death knight talent located on tier 8 of the Frost tree.

Una Wolfclaw is a female orc at Grol'dom Farm in the Northern Barrens. She can be found in one of the farm's central buildings, alternating between fending off Razormane Pillagers with her bow and tending to a couple of injured grunts. She was present during the Legion Invasions.
Unbreakable Steel is an Arms warrior artifact trait. It is only available after acquiring all other artifact traits.
Unbreakable Bulwark is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is not linked to any other traits and requires all other base traits to be learned.
Unbound Chaos was an Azerite trait available to Havoc demon hunters.
Undercommon is a language known by the half-orc skeletal mage, Chauch-eta. Nothing more is known about this language.
Underking Talonox is a crypt lord stationed at Scourgeholme in Icecrown. He is found circling the statue in the Pit of Fiends, where he holds court. Highlord Darion Mograine helps to kill Talonox.

Uncle Bedlam is a prominent member of the Bilgewater Battalion who resides in Bilgewater Harbor of Azshara. He appears to be the Battalion’s mascot, promoter, or some other informal leader. The goblin featured on the Wrenchmen Recruitment Poster is likely Uncle Bedlam because of the physical similarities and relation to Uncle Sam and military recruitment.

Underseer Bloodmane is an orc of the Iron Horde. His prize talbuk, Prize, is with him inside the building on Engineer Trak's rise northeast of Mor'gran Logworks in northeastern Talador. Try to keep Prize alive, as if the talbuk dies first, Bloodmane will Enrage.
Understudy Zyzzix is a fel orc located at The Fel Forge in Tanaan Jungle.
Uncontrolled Rage is a Fury warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Helya's Wrath (artifact trait), Raging Berserker, and Wild Slashes (artifact trait) traits.
Underbelly Bonnie is a human located at the Circle of Wills in Dalaran. She can be found sleeping next to her pet rat Bastard.
Undalog was a drogbar leader who had been stealing eagle eggs in order to feed his worms. He was taken down in his cave by the Hidden Path in order to protect the eagles from extinction.

Undravius is a fel lord commander that participated in the War of the Ancients, intending to end the life on Azeroth. As his crystalline eye was found in Stormheim, the demon was very likely defeated there at some point.
Unger Statforth is a human horse vendor located in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
Unleashed Fury is a hunter talent from the Beast Mastery tree. It improves the damage your pet dishes out.
Unholy Presence is a death knight Presence available at level 70.
Unholy Rune Mastery was a death knight talent located on tier 5 of the Unholy tree.

Ungra is an orc lieutenant of in the Umbral Halls of Tanaan Jungle. When Luuka was captured by the orcs, she would consider Ungra, Gurran and Ankova the meanest. However, Luuka was found and protected by an intruding adventurer and Yrel who confronted the Masters of Shadow - Ungra would order someone to inform Keli'dan of the intrusion before her defeat.
Unkala Stormgrinder is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Unholy Mutation is an Unholy death knight honor talent, available at rank 10.
Unending Hatred is a demon hunter PvP talent, available at level 20.
Unending Rage is an Arms warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Many Will Fall, Touch of Zakajz, and Void Cleave traits.
Unleashed Demons is a Havoc demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Warglaives of Chaos, Balanced Blades (demon hunter artifact trait) and Demon Speed traits.
Unholy Endurance is an Unholy death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Scourge the Unbeliever, The Shambler and Deadliest Coil (death knight artifact trait) traits.
Unerring Arrows is a Marksmanship hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Acuity of the Unseen Path and Feet of Wind traits.
Unending Thirst is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the All-Consuming Rot trait.
Unknown Soldier is a human ghost located at the Lost Estate in Stormsong Valley.
Unison is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Mending Proliferation.
Unleashed Inferno is a Fire mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Sun King's Blessing.
Unquenchable Thirst is a level 45 warrior talent. It is available to Fury warriors.
Unsuspecting Horseman is a human killed by Lilian Voss in Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound.
Urek Thunderhorn is a tauren hunter trainer located on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.
Ursyn Ghull is a Forsaken mage trainer located at the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.
Ur'kyo was a jungle troll priest trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. He has been referred to as the greatest of the tribe's priests.
Urga'zz is the leader of a gang of gan'arg found in the Thrallmar Mine in Hellfire Peninsula. Foreman Razelcraz wants him dead.
Ureda is an orc mage trainer found in the Arcane Enclave in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. She is a renowned mage.
Ursula Direbrew is a Dark Iron dwarf that spawns alongside Ilsa Direbrew in the Grim Guzzler, inside Blackrock Depths, when Coren Direbrew is engaged in a fight and reaches 35% of health.
Urk Gagbaz is an orc armor vendor located at Crown Guard Tower within Eastern Plaguelands.

Uragos was the leader of the five blue dragons: Rulagos, Rulagosa, Pelagosa and Lurugos, charged with moving the Focusing Iris to a secure location. He was the oldest of the group, known to be mild-tempered and wise. He was killed along with the other escorts by members of the Horde who wished to steal the artifact.
Urela Bloodrock is an orc banker in Warspear Hold in Warspear on Ashran.
Unyielding Strikes is a level 45 warrior talent. It is available to Protection warriors.
Upchuckle is an orc located at the Broken Horn Village in Gorgrond.
Urgra is an orc scribe located in the Frostwall's Scribe's Quarters. For scribes, she will sell new formulas. For non-scribes, she will make items instead.
Urkag is an orc vendor located outside the Bloodmaul Slag Mines in Frostfire Ridge.

Urk is an orc who is a patron of the Hearthstone inn. An orc who is smarter than he looks. Or acts. More sensitive than he seems. Still running up a huge tab in broken tables. Has an axe for every occasion.
Urok Windcleaver is an orc located in Southwind Village in Silithus: The Wound.
Uraka Wildthunder is a Mag'har orc located in Tiragarde Sound alongside Quizla Blastcaps. She later appeared in the Zocalo in Zuldazar, working with Ricket on an Experimental Warboat.
Uselessness is a projection of a nightmare dragon located in Ardenweald.
Upwelling is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Focused Thunder.
Usodormu is a bronze dragon in goblin visage located at the Temporal Conflux in Thaldraszus.
Upligosa was a blue dragon who was killed in the Crystalsong forest disaster. Her name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Uthrar Threx is a dwarf located in the Great Forge in Ironforge.
Va'jashni is a troll priest, and is part of Theldren's team of gladiators at the Blackrock Depths arena.

Valdaron was a night elf tailoring vendor located in Auberdine in Darkshore. His corpse can now be found on the beach, having been killed during the escape from Auberdine, possibly by murlocs or Twilight's Hammer cultists. Vicious gashes line Valdaron's body. You need not check his pulse to know he has already passed.

Uthrok is an orc bow and gun vendor located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He was present during the Legion Invasions shooting demons. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he joined the Unseen Path in the Trueshot Lodge. He later traveled to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. During Death Rising, he was defending the town with a bow in his hands.
Uttnar is an orc meat vendor located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
Uthok is an orc general goods vendor located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
Valaatu is a draenei mage trainer located at the Crash Site in Azuremyst Isle.

Uthul was an orc belonging to the Frostwolf clan. He provoked Thrall into attacking him, but this was Drek'thar's plan in order to wake Thrall´s pride. Uthul and Thrall eventually became friends. When Snowsong was choosing her life companion, Uthul wished she would choose him, but she chose Thrall. Nevertheless, Uthul was the first to congratulate Thrall.
Uvlus Banefire is a Forsaken mage located in Light's Hammer of Icecrown Citadel. She sells the Tier 10 armor for mages.
Val'dune Fleshcrafter is an orc located at the Bladefist Hold in Spires of Arak.
Valant Brightsworn is the Alliance paladin leader in Stormshield Outpost, Ashran. He serves to summon patrols for the Alliance.
Vala Kaliraan is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Vaal'kelthos Dawngrief is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.

Utona Wolfeye is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, she appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Valassa Lara was a night elf ghost located in Azsuna and Stormheim. Expressing your wish for treasure would apply the buff granted by the treasure map items corresponding to the current zone.
Val'thryzel is a fel lord that appears in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Uungbrul is a drogbar Trade Goods vendor and member of the Stonedark tribe who appears in the Hall of Chieftains in Thunder Totem after completing Unexpected Allies.

Vadekius was a green dragon who fell in Drustvar ages ago. His remains lay in what came to be known as Vadekius's Rest until the melting snow revealed them. Alexstrasza sent Zallestrasza to enchant the body to prevent it from being raised. Though the death knight Danir Emberlight attempted to turn Vadekius into a frost wyrm, he was defeated and the bones were protected from undeath.

Utama was an ankoan warrior who lies buried at Utama's Stand in Nazjatar. Utama attempted to hide from the naga in Kal'methir but discovered it was overrun with makrura and died in battle after being surrounded by the Kil'karrok makrura. To demonstrate their dedication to the ankoan, Blademaster Okani tasks Alliance adventurers with avenging him.
Vaayu Hestavari is a human located at the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores. She can be found working at the forge using the Light.

Utok Scratcher was an apprentice shaman and chief advisor to the ruthless commander of the Blackrock clan, Orgrim Doomhammer. He was the author of The Dominion of Lordaeron, which recorded the Horde's actions during the Second War. He was called "Scratcher" because of his habit of scribbling rather than mindlessly killing, but he would soon be the one who laughed. For too long his people had ignored their need to record their methods. He was confident that his chronicles would benefit only those who recognized this need, but mostly because there were very few of his kind who could read. As a follower of the mystic arts, he was intensely aware that the devouring of a world was of the highest

Valormok is an orc-controlled Horde outpost in Azshara. It was originally found to the northwest, north of the Haldarr Encampment. In Cataclysm the area was moved to the southwest. The original location was fairly unprotected and bare, as the Horde had initial little interest in this hostile territory, though the new outpost was reinforced by the time of the return of Deathwing.
Valisha is a human arcanist, and friend of the night elf Zur.
Valorous Frostfire Garb is the 25-man version of the tier 7 mage set.
Valorous Dreamwalker Garb is the 25-man version of the tier 7 balance druid set.
Valorous Redemption Plate is the 25-man version of the tier 7 protection paladin set.
Valorous Dreadnaught Plate is the 25-man version of the tier 7 tank warrior set.
Valorous Dreamwalker Regalia is the 25-man version of the tier 7 restoration druid set.
Valorous Dreamwalker Battlegear is the 25-man version of the tier 7 feral druid set.
